title: The last log
logline: The last log on the carriage, 1994, going into the head saw, the uncle's hand on the lever, the cut opening in a plane of ochre. The page draws the middle of the cut and stops.

panels.composition: A cedar log on a saw carriage going into a head saw, the cut opening in a plane of ochre, a broad man's hand on a lever from the side, sawdust as black spotting.
